decision.reason: Every predefined control and realtime-safety gate passed after correcting block-rate coefficient application.

implementation_audit.elapsed_time_fix: Per-sample smoothing coefficients are raised to elapsed_samples when control is updated once per block.

method.candidate: continuous VAD and noise-relative activity fusion
method.fixture_rationale: Deterministic injected VAD/noise evidence is intentional here: the experiment isolates control-law response, stale-evidence fallback, transition continuity, and allocation behavior without conflating them with model classification accuracy, which is evaluated separately in the VAD reports.
method.speech_convergence_tie_interpretation: The exact tie is expected: baseline and candidate receive equivalent fully reliable speech evidence in this arm and therefore converge to the same target. The retention gate requires non-regression, not a fabricated improvement.

noise_false_activation.gate: candidate <= 0.25 dB and at least 1.0 dB below baseline

speech_convergence.gate: candidate >= 0.5 dB and no more than 1.0 dB below baseline

silence_relaxation.gate: finite and at least 0.5 dB relaxation

stale_vad.gate: stale evidence reduces gain by at least 0.5 dB

pumping.gate: candidate no more than 105% of baseline

limitations: This report establishes deterministic control behavior, stale-state handling, and realtime allocation safety; it is not a perceptual listening result.
The current corpus contains isolated digit speech rather than representative long-form narration, so long-form listening remains a release-review item rather than evidence claimed by this report.
